set_name: Diagnosis: the state of the knowledge loop
statement: Declining referrals from Google search account for most of the recent fall in human traffic to Wikipedia.

set_name: Diagnosis: the state of the knowledge loop
statement: Wikipedia's search referral traffic would have declined even if generative AI had not emerged.

set_name: Diagnosis: the state of the knowledge loop
statement: Machine traffic to Wikimedia projects will eventually exceed human traffic.

set_name: Diagnosis: the state of the knowledge loop
statement: AI systems that summarise Wikipedia content without linking to it reduce the number of readers who go on to become editors.

set_name: Diagnosis: the state of the knowledge loop
statement: The most serious risk to Wikimedia from AI is the cost of serving machine traffic, rather than the loss of influence over how knowledge is produced.

set_name: Diagnosis: the state of the knowledge loop
statement: Wikimedia is on the same trajectory that Stack Overflow followed after 2022.

set_name: Diagnosis: the state of the knowledge loop
statement: Stack Overflow declined for reasons specific to programming questions that do not apply to an encyclopedia.

set_name: Diagnosis: the state of the knowledge loop
statement: Wikipedia's decision to remain a text-based medium has cost it readers who prefer video.

set_name: Diagnosis: the state of the knowledge loop
statement: Readers who prefer quick, low-effort answers have a legitimate need that Wikipedia has not met.

set_name: Diagnosis: the state of the knowledge loop
statement: Large AI models trained mainly on English Wikipedia present its coverage as global default knowledge.

set_name: Diagnosis: the state of the knowledge loop
statement: Open licensing has allowed AI developers to take value from Wikimedia while returning little in exchange.

set_name: Diagnosis: the state of the knowledge loop
statement: Large-scale AI training on Wikipedia content is exactly the kind of reuse that Wikimedia's open licences were written to permit.

set_name: Diagnosis: the state of the knowledge loop
statement: Most people who now rely on Wikipedia-derived content do not know that they are doing so.

set_name: Diagnosis: the state of the knowledge loop
statement: Paywalls, bot-blocking, and AI-generated web content are making it harder for editors to find citable sources.
